effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom from msg.sender).
The vault mints shares (kmgcUSDC) to `receiver`; the number is computed from the vault rate after the deposit fee, which is read from storage.
The vault may mint reward-fee shares to itself before the deposit, which dilutes the share price slightly (storage-driven).
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the USDC amount sent, the share ticker kmgcUSDC, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets; the number comes from the vault rate and the deposit fee.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `(uint256 _shares, uint256 _depositFeeAmount) = _previewDeposit(assets, _newTotalAssets, totalSupply());` and _previewDeposit: `depositFeeAmount = assets.mulDiv($._depositFee, ...)`. The descriptor has no shares field, only 'Share ticker' raw kmgcUSDC.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share count. Optionally change the label to 'Receive shares (vault rate, after fee)'.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name the asset or the vault shares received.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC for vault shares", and add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for shares to {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends a USDC amount that the vault computes from `shares`, the vault rate and the deposit fee (rounded up). No maximum is in the calldata.
The vault mints exactly `shares` kmgcUSDC to `receiver`.
The vault may mint reward-fee shares to itself before the mint (storage-driven).
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', 'Deposit asset: USDC' (ticker only), the number of shares minted, and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the wallet; the vault computes it and the calldata has no maximum.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol mint: `(uint256 _assets, uint256 _depositFeeAmount) = _previewMint(shares, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply);` then `_deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, _assets, shares, _depositFeeAmount);`. Descriptor shows only `"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the USDC amount. Change the label to 'Pays in (amount set by vault rate)' so the signer knows it is not fixed.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that USDC leaves the wallet to buy the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`; Vault._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(IERC20(asset()), caller, address(this), assets);`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC to mint vault shares", and add interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} to {receiver}, paid in USDC".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns shares from `owner`; the number is computed from `assets` and the vault rate (rounded up).
When the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from `owner` is spent by that number of shares.
The vault withdraws `assets` USDC from the underlying protocol through a delegatecalled connector and sends the balance gained to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', 'Withdraw exactly' the USDC amount, 'To' the receiver, and 'Owner' of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many kmgcUSDC shares the owner loses; the vault computes it from its rate.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `uint256 _shares = _convertToShares(assets, Math.Rounding.Ceil, _accrueRewardFee(), totalSupply());` then `_withdraw(...)` with `_burn(owner, shares)`. No shares field in the descriptor.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share count. Optionally add a constant field naming the share token burned (kmgcUSDC).

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' does not say that vault shares are burned for USDC.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw USDC from vault", and add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` kmgcUSDC from `owner`; when the signer is not `owner`, the signer's allowance is spent by `shares`.
The vault withdraws a USDC amount it computes from `shares` and the vault rate (rounded down) and sends it to `receiver`. No minimum is in the calldata.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', 'Shares to redeem' with the share token, 'To' the receiver, and 'Owner'.

findings.title: redeem does not name USDC as the asset the receiver gets; nothing on the screen states it.
findings.evidence: Vault._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20(asset()), receiver, IERC20(asset()).balanceOf(address(this)) - _balanceBefore);`. Descriptor redeem fields: 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner'; no field uses underlyingTicker, unlike the mint format.
findings.fix: Add a field `{"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` and change the intent to "Redeem shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC the receiver gets; the vault computes it and the calldata has no minimum.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `uint256 _assets = _convertToAssets(shares, Math.Rounding.Floor, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply);`. ERC-4626 redeem has no minimum-out parameter.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the USDC amount.

couldNotCheck: Vault._withdraw and Vault._deposit delegatecall a connector that the connector registry resolves at runtime ($._connectorRegistry.getOrRevert($._connectorName), MORPHO_GAUNTLET_USDC_CORE). Its source is not in the directory. The connector decides how much USDC reaches the receiver in withdraw and redeem (the balance gained after IConnector.withdraw), so I could not check the 'Withdraw exactly' amount.
